# Script value types

The value types every script holds without a `use`: the engine's vectors
and colours arrive as them, each a struct of floats a script reads and
builds by field. Read from a booted engine.

| Type | Fields |
| --- | --- |
| `Vec2` | `x`, `y` |
| `Vec3` | `x`, `y`, `z` |
| `Color` | `r`, `g`, `b`, `a` |

## Built-in functions

Called by name, with no module before them.

| Function | Signature |
| --- | --- |
| `color` | `fn color(r: float, g: float, b: float, a: float) -> Color` |
| `vec2` | `fn vec2(x: float, y: float) -> Vec2` |
| `vec3` | `fn vec3(x: float, y: float, z: float) -> Vec3` |
